
Release Procedure
=================

Source Code
___________

Compile cyboi using "make cyboi"
Test cybol by executing all example applications by Running make test
Analyse code using tools "valgrind" and "cppcheck"
Update api (logic and state) in directory "src/constant/format/cybol/"

Build
_____

Change project version in build/CMakeList.txt
Run make adjustCopyright
Adapt directories, files, version in file "build/cmake/packaging.cmake"
Build project using "make clean" and "make"

Update files in directory "todo/"
Update ChangeLog
Update AUTHORS reading ChangeLog entries
Update NEWS subsumpting ChangeLog entries

Website
_______

Create new file for release in www/website/development/plan/
Copy content from NEWS to www/website/development/plan/cybop-x.x.x.html
Update www/website/development/plan/index.html
Upload website changes

Distribution
____________

Commit SVN
Tag SVN
Create tarball using "cpack"
Create GPG binary signature for tarball file
Upload tarball file to Savannah
Announce release in mailing list cybop-developers@nongnu.org
